Laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection was identified among 324 (5.1%) of 6,328 fully vaccinated persons
the odds of laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 were higher among previously infected, unvaccinated patients than among fully vaccinated patients
the aOR was higher for patients aged ≥65 years (aOR = 19.57) than for those aged 18–64 years
Vaccination status was documented in electronic health records and immunization registries.

methods_quotes.q: aORs and 95% CIs were calculated using multivariable logistic regression
weighted based on propensity to be in the vaccinated category
Established methods were used to calculate weights to account for differences in sociodemographic and health characteristics between groups
aORs were stratified by mRNA vaccine product and age group.
p-values <0.2 were considered indicative of a statistically significant difference in aOR by product or age
